'''Gial Gahan''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. He had been a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] for [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] and by [[130 ABY]], he was a member of the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]]. Gahan was a staunch supporter of the [[New Jedi Order]], unlike his fellow Triumvir [[Nu Toreena]], who held the Jedi responsible for the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. He was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Darth Krayt]] during an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Massacre of New Coral City|attack]] on Dac.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I do not ''deny'' my actions, but I ''alone'' am responsible for them.|Gial Gahan, to Darth Krayt|<ref name="Legacy 22" />}}
Prior to becoming a member of the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], Gial Gahan served as governor of the Hub, the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and acted as a liaison to the Mon Calamari defense forces and the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Following the Alliance surrender at the [[Battle of Caamas]], Gial retired to his homeworld of Mon Calamari, now under [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] occupation and ruled by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. There he secretly supplied spare parts, [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], and other supplies to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. He was the uncle of [[Monia Gahan]], a member of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and one of Stazi's followers.

He was part of the plot to aid Stazi's capture of the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|Advanced Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']]. However, he was captured by Imperials under the command of Admiral [[Dru Valan]]'s forces after disabling the planetary defenses. But this was a diversion so Monia could hack into the station's computer and reprogram the guns to target Imperial ships. Gar Stazi was successful in stealing the ''Imperious''.

[[File:DeathofGialGahan.jpg|thumb|left|Gial Gahan is killed by Darth Krayt.]]
[[Darth Krayt]], angered by both the theft of the ''Imperious'' and [[Cade Skywalker]]'s escape from him, arrived on Mon Calamari and proceeded to the [[Mon Calamari Council]]. There, he announced to both the council and holonet that one-tenth of the Mon Calamari population would be [[Genocide on Dac|eliminated]]. He then had the entire Mon Calamari Council, Calamari and any Quarren who disagreed, [[Massacre of New Coral City|slaughtered]]. Gahan furiously protested this, saying it was genocide, and Krayt agreed and proceeded to execute Gahan personally.
